_comment: 由 tools/zh/zh.py text-extract 生成；zh 为空表示未翻译（回退原文）。控制码沿用 <LINE>/<DONE>/<PLAYER> 等写法，{{n}} 为不可翻译的占位命令，必须原样保留。

OfferGoodRodText.en: Olivine is on the<LINE>sea!<PARA>And if it's on the<LINE>sea, there are<CONT>bound to be fish!<PARA>I've fished here<LINE>for 30 years.<PARA>Would you like to<LINE>face the sea and<CONT>fish?<DONE>
OfferGoodRodText.zh: 浅葱市<LINE>面向大海！<PARA>既然<LINE>面朝大海，<PARA>就一定<LINE>有鱼！<PARA>我在这里<LINE>钓了<CONT>30年。<PARA>你想<LINE>对着大海<CONT>钓鱼吗？<DONE>

GiveGoodRodText.en: Ah, hahah!<LINE>We have ourselves<CONT>a new angler!<DONE>
GiveGoodRodText.zh: 啊，哈哈哈！<PARA>又多了<LINE>一位<CONT>钓鱼人！<DONE>

GaveGoodRodText.en: Fish aren't found<LINE>in the sea alone.<PARA>They go wherever<LINE>there is water.<DONE>
GaveGoodRodText.zh: 鱼<LINE>不只<CONT>在海里。<PARA>有水的<LINE>地方<CONT>就有鱼。<DONE>

DontWantGoodRodText.zh: 什——么？<LINE>你不喜欢<CONT>钓鱼？！<PARA>难以理解！<DONE>

HaveGoodRodText.en: How are things?<LINE>Land the big one?<DONE>
